name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), the closest bar to LAX, open since 1952.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue (Taco Tuesday, 11 AM to midnight): classic tacos $4 each, elevated tacos $6.99 each, and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3.
Karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs happen every week.
Melody Rewards is free to join. You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip).
Join bonus: +100 points. Birthday bonus: +250 once a year. Referral: +100 per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Rewards: 250 pts free soft drink or Melody Fries; 500 pts $10 off your check; 1,000 pts free starter; 1,500 pts free entree (up to $21.50).
You can use one reward per day, and rewards are never free alcohol.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Melody Approach is a free flying game with Campaign and Survival weekly boards that reset every Monday.
Game rewards are in BETA: the boards are live for bragging rights and prizes switch on soon.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
No app download. It opens in your phone browser and you can add it to your Home Screen.
Nalu Vida (Venice Pier) is the sister spot and has its own separate points balance.

How do I play Melody Approach?
How do I join Melody Rewards?

qa.q: Where is Melody Bar & Grill?
qa.a: We're at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester. Tap Directions in the app to get a map.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call us at (310) 670-1994, or tap the Call button in the app.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're usually open Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so please call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late at night.

qa.q: What time does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen's closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: Yes, parking is free, including a free lot for people picking up travelers.

qa.q: Can I walk from LAX?
qa.a: Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Melody is also about 5 minutes from LAX by car.

qa.q: How close are you to the airport?
qa.a: We're the closest bar to LAX, about 5 minutes away.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3-6 every day.

qa.q: What are the happy hour prices?
qa.a: The app doesn't list happy hour prices. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 for today's deals.

qa.q: Do I earn extra points during happy hour?
qa.a: The app doesn't mention bonus points at happy hour. You still earn points on every check, so show your app to your server and add your visit.

qa.q: What are the daily specials?
qa.a: Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue (Taco Tuesday, 11 AM to midnight): classic tacos $4 each, elevated tacos $6.99 each, and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3. Happy hour is 3-6 daily.

qa.q: What's the Monday special?
qa.a: Half off burgers from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What's the Tuesday special?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday is Tuesdays only, 11 AM to midnight. Classic tacos are $4 each: Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas. Elevated Taco Specials are $6.99 each: Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, Smash Burger Taco, and Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco. Margaritas are $6.

qa.q: Is there a Wednesday special?
qa.a: The app doesn't list a Wednesday food special. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What's the Thursday special?
qa.a: Half off sandwiches from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What's the Friday special?
qa.a: $3 sliders from 11 to 3.

qa.q: Are the margarita specials all day?
qa.a: On Tuesdays margaritas are $6. The app doesn't give exact hours for it, so ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: What's happening every week?
qa.a: Every week there's karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.

qa.q: When is karaoke?
qa.a: Karaoke runs every week, and Wednesday nights from about 10 PM are the usual night. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.

qa.q: Do you have live music or DJs?
qa.a: Yes, live bands and DJs play every week. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 for the schedule.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: The app doesn't list cover charges. Watching games and happy hour are usually no cover. Ask staff about late DJ nights.

qa.q: Can I watch the game at Melody?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. Tap Today's games in the app for LA and California scores and where to watch.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation details. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you host private events?
qa.a: The app doesn't cover private events. Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask.

qa.q: Is Melody kid friendly?
qa.a: I don't have an age policy for evenings or late nights. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you deliver or do takeout?
qa.a: You can pick To go in the app. I don't have delivery details, so ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: How do I sign up for Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap to become a member in the app. It's free and takes about 10 seconds, and you get a gold rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, joining is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get +100 points once when you join, plus your gold Melody Rewards card.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip). You can also earn bonus points from birthdays, referrals, the games and a one-time location bonus.

qa.q: What is the points ratio?
qa.a: 10 points for every $1 you spend on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get my points for a visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once Toast is connected this will be automatic.

qa.q: Are there limits on adding a visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check only once, and up to $150 per check. Points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points if I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. Pay your server or bartender like normal and you still earn points on every check.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: The app doesn't say your points expire. The program can change with notice in the app, and points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500 pts: free entree up to $21.50.

qa.q: How many points for a free drink or fries?
qa.a: 250 points gets you a free soft drink or Melody Fries.

qa.q: How many points for $10 off?
qa.a: 500 points gets you $10 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free starter?
qa.a: 1,000 points gets you a free starter: Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: How many points for a free meal?
qa.a: 1,500 points gets you a free entree up to $21.50: a Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: How do I use a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward in the app and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. Your next code comes on your next visit.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date), with no stacking. A second prize shows Come back tomorrow.

qa.q: Can I give my rewards to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: The app doesn't have levels or tiers. You just collect points and trade them for rewards.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes, you get +250 points once a year on your birthday as a member.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Share your code. You get +100 points for each friend who joins with it and makes a first visit.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's code later?
qa.a: No. You enter one friend's code once when you join. It can't be changed later, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: What is the location bonus?
qa.a: It's a one-time +100 points. Turn on nearby alerts, and if location and notifications are on when you open the app on at least 3 different days across at least 7 days, it's added automatically.

qa.q: Do I have to turn on location?
qa.a: No, it's optional. Nothing is turned on without your tap and your phone's permission, and you can turn it off anytime in the app or your phone's Settings.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for leaving a review?
qa.a: The app offers +50 points once per member for telling us how we did.

qa.q: What is Just Landed?
qa.a: Landed at LAX in the last 24 hours? Show your boarding pass to your server for 10% off your first order today.

qa.q: Can I combine Just Landed with other offers?
qa.a: No. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: It's our free arcade flying game. Fly over LA in Campaign (10 levels) or Survival (no finish line) and compete on weekly boards.

qa.q: How do I play Melody Approach?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the boost button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo. Shoot enemies, dodge their fire and catch Melody's food.

qa.q: What's Campaign mode?
qa.a: Campaign has 10 levels of about 45 seconds each over LA, each a little harder, with six boss fights, then a landing at LAX. Your score is what counts.

qa.q: What's Survival mode?
qa.a: Survival has no finish line and keeps getting harder. Your time survived is what counts.

qa.q: How many hits can my plane take?
qa.a: Three hits and your plane goes down, which ends the game. Every enemy attack is warned first.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, and ammo refills from ammo crates.

qa.q: Can I play without fighting?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the swords button, or turn combat off in the Pause menu, for a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: How many times can I play the game?
qa.a: It's free to play, with or without an account. The app doesn't set a limit on plays.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Games are free to play with or without an account, and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two boards: Campaign (ranked by score) and Survival (ranked by longest time). Both reset every Monday. Practice and test flights don't count.

qa.q: Who wins the weekly prize?
qa.a: Once prizes switch on, the top player on each weekly board may win the weekly prize shown in the game (for example, free Melody Fries).

qa.q: Are the game prizes live yet?
qa.a: Not yet. The game is in BETA, so the boards are live for bragging rights and prizes switch on soon. Right now the game gives no prizes, codes, discounts or points.

qa.q: How do I put my score on the board?
qa.a: After your flight, tap Post my score on the end screen.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The weekly boards reset every Monday. I don't have the exact time or how winners are contacted, so please ask staff.

qa.q: How do game points work?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on, your score turns into points at 1 point per 100 score. You can earn at most 50 game points a day.

qa.q: Can I cheat on the board?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: What is the Melody Games Pack?
qa.a: It's Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix (word scramble) and Truth or Dare. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.

qa.q: How does Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick a category and answer questions against the clock. Faster right answers score more. Play solo or pass the phone with 2-6 players.

qa.q: How does Sports Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick your team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a Fan Rating, or play all LA sports.

qa.q: What is Melody Word?
qa.a: It's one daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints per word, and a new word comes every day at midnight LA time.

qa.q: What is Melody Mix?
qa.a: It's a word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out, with 3 skips.

qa.q: What is Truth or Dare?
qa.a: It's a fun table game for 1-6 players with light truths and silly dares. It's just for fun with no points. Dares never involve drinking and anyone can pass.

qa.q: How many points can the games give me?
qa.a: Once rewards are on, Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round). Melody Mix gives 1 per 2 words (up to 3). Melody Word gives 3 points, or 2 or 1 if you use hints. The daily cap is 10 Games Pack points.

qa.q: What is Who Wins?
qa.a: It's a free pick on LA games just for fun, with no money or wagers. Once rewards are on, a right pick made before the game starts earns 2 points, up to 6 a day. Picks lock when the game starts.

qa.q: Can I see live scores?
qa.a: Yes. The LA Scoreboard shows live scores from ESPN, for information only (no streams). Tap Today's games for details and where to watch.

qa.q: What is Football Squares?
qa.a: It's a game with one board per NFL or college game. Each member can get one free square per board, and entries close at kickoff when the numbers are drawn.

qa.q: How do I get a free square?
qa.a: Tap Get my free square in the app. It's free for every Rewards member and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: Can I get more squares?
qa.a: Yes. Each eligible purchase can add one more square. Show your Rewards card and staff add a Squares ticket. Each board has a per-person limit.

qa.q: How do you win Football Squares?
qa.a: At the end of Q1, halftime, Q3 and the final, the last digit of each team's score picks the winning square. Prizes are shown on the board before you play.

qa.q: What can I win in Football Squares?
qa.a: Prizes like food, merch, % off the check, a free non-alcoholic drink, or % off a drink (21+ with ID). No cash, gift cards or free alcohol.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: Scan the table code or pick where you're sitting (table, bar, patio or to go) in the app. Add items and tap Send my order.

qa.q: Do I pay in the app?
qa.a: No. You pay your server or bartender like normal, and you still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What if I don't pick a seat?
qa.a: The app asks you to pick where you're sitting first so your order goes to the right place. If you scanned a table code, it's already picked.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: The app menu has Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, Taco Tuesday (Tuesdays only), and Tacos & Burritos, plus a drinks list. Browse it in the app.

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings, Avocado Toast, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries, Chicken Pot Stickers, Fried Green Beans, Fried Shrimp, Jalapeno Calamari, Lettuce Wraps and Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: House Mac ($15), Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno ($17.25), Parmesan & Mushroom ($17.25), Chicken Parmesan ($18.25), Melody Burger Mac ($19.25) and Lobster ($21.50).

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos (2 per order): Shrimp, Salmon, Carnitas, Chicken, Avocado and Beyond. Burritos: Carnitas, Steak, Chicken and Bean & Cheese. Nachos and a Cheese Quesadilla too. On Tuesdays there is a Taco Tuesday menu: classic tacos $4 each and Elevated Taco Specials $6.99 each.

qa.q: What's the Melody Burger?
qa.a: Grilled Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries ($19.25).

qa.q: What soups and fries do you have?
qa.a: Soups: French Onion, Tomato Bisque and Black Bean. Fries: Gilroy Garlic, Melody, Phat, Philly Cheese Steak and Sweet Potato Fries, plus Onion Strings.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: The app lists Mango Margarita, House Margarita, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, Draft Beer, Mimosa, Round of Shots and a Bucket of Beers (5).

qa.q: How much are drinks?
qa.a: Drink prices shown in the app are previews until Melody signs off. Ask your server for current prices.

qa.q: Are there vegan or vegetarian options?
qa.a: Yes, the app menu includes Beyond Tacos, Avocado Tacos, Avocado Toast, Bean & Cheese Burrito, House Mac and more. Ask your server about ingredients and allergies.

qa.q: Do you have breakfast or brunch?
qa.a: I don't have breakfast or brunch details in the app. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages.

qa.q: How do I get the app?
qa.a: There's nothing to download. Open it in your phone's browser from the Instagram link or the QR code on your table, then add it to your Home Screen.

qa.q: Can I put my rewards card in my phone wallet?
qa.a: Wallet buttons aren't turned on yet. Your gold Melody Rewards card is in the app under My Rewards Card, with your points and QR.

qa.q: How do notifications work?
qa.a: They're optional. On iPhone you need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer). Any reminders are scheduled, like lunch or happy hour.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: Yes, the games have a kid mode that hides the adult-only games. Dares never involve drinking.

qa.q: What data does the app collect?
qa.a: Each time you open it (at most every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary and a random phone ID. Approximate location is recorded only if you turned location on. It is never sold and not used for ads.

qa.q: How do I turn off location and alerts?
qa.a: Tap Turn off nearby alerts in the app and/or switch off Location and Notifications for the site in your phone's Settings. Points you've earned stay.

qa.q: What is Nalu Vida?
qa.a: It's our sister spot at the Venice Pier. It has its own points balance, and points don't move between restaurants.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.
